mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultation (member_id, reservation_id, treatment_id, admin_id, consultation_status, consultation_memo, preferred_date, preferred_time, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{reservationId}, #{treatmentId}, #{adminId}, COALESCE(#{consultationStatus}, 'RECEIVED'), #{consultationMemo}, #{preferredDate}, #{preferredTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT consultation_id, member_id, reservation_id, treatment_id, admin_id, consultation_status, consultation_memo, preferred_date, preferred_time, created_at, updated_at FROM consultation ORDER BY consultation_id

SELECT consultation_id, member_id, reservation_id, treatment_id, admin_id, consultation_status, consultation_memo, preferred_date, preferred_time, created_at, updated_at FROM consultation WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY consultation_id

SELECT consultation_id, member_id, reservation_id, treatment_id, admin_id, consultation_status, consultation_memo, preferred_date, preferred_time, created_at, updated_at FROM consultation WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} ORDER BY consultation_id

SELECT consultation_id, member_id, reservation_id, treatment_id, admin_id, consultation_status, consultation_memo, preferred_date, preferred_time, created_at, updated_at FROM consultation WHERE consultation_status = #{consultationStatus} ORDER BY consultation_id
mapper.update: UPDATE consultation SET reservation_id = #{reservationId}, treatment_id = #{treatmentId}, admin_id = #{adminId}, consultation_status = #{consultationStatus}, consultation_memo = #{consultationMemo}, preferred_date = #{preferredDate}, preferred_time = #{preferredTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE consultation_id = #{consultationId}
UPDATE consultation SET admin_id = #{adminId}, consultation_status = #{consultationStatus}, consultation_memo = #{consultationMemo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE consultation_id = #{consultationId}

UPDATE consultation SET reservation_id = #{reservationId}, admin_id = #{adminId}, consultation_status = 'CONVERTED', consultation_memo = #{consultationMemo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE consultation_id = #{consultationId}
